what_it_does: Proposes MAS-ISP, a real-time optimization system for Image Signal Processors (specialized chips that enhance camera images in autonomous vehicles). Environmental conditions like lighting and weather change constantly; traditional offline parameter tuning cannot adapt. MAS-ISP uses Deep Reinforcement Learning with multi-agent coordination to continuously tune Image Signal Processor parameters at runtime. Also introduces hardware innovations including Strip Convolution (a more efficient way to apply image filtering) and Stride-Aware Dual-Buffer Memory to reduce resource requirements.
